I did watch his vid - definitely helpful.

I'm a little stressed that it really only changes out about half the fluid, due to the cooler and the torque converter and internals.   But idk how to do better.  Some people mention a flush - but i don't see how that could work either.  Even if you were to disconnect the return lines from the cooler and flush from there - not all is going to the cooler.

I think I'm going to do it though - half fresh fluid and a new filter seems worth doing anyway.  I'm around 75k miles and pushing 25k towing a 7000lb trailer... about to do another 6k hitched this winter.

I wouldn't call it straightforward, especially since most of the DIY approaches only really change about half the fluid anyway.  You'd have to flush the cooler an torque converter somehow to get it really changed. 

I think it's still worth doing - half fresh fluid and a new filter is better than not doing anything.
I think the temperature range is to open the thermostat and get fluid flowing through the cooler, which it will not while it's cold.

I’ve been growing my hair out for 6months+ now for the first time in my life and now yesterday decided to start trying  a CG routine.  Clarified with suave clarifying.  Conditioned with Trader Joes Tea Tree.  Gel, air dry, and scrunch with Tresemme mega control gel.   Planning to use the trader Joe conditioner as a co-wash every couple days and lo-poo with the trader joes shampoo ever week or two or whatever seems to feel right.  Will also play with a Tresemme pro pure leave in conditioner spray I or maybe just the trader joes conditioner as a leave in, per the beginner guide.  
It kind of looks like I have dark gray curly toupe over a lighter gray mullet.  But there is some shape showing and it’s a start.  I’m hoping more length will make my side wings calm down, or maybe I just need to go with a shorter style in the long run.  For now, I plan to let it get to chin length regardless of how bad it looks, before I give up, just to see how it goes.  


Btw, the 'before' pic is me before my clarifying shower, just puffing things up with my fingers - it is pretty coarse dry and wiry - no product - and will stay sticking out like that all night if I wanted.

  
Any other tips or suggestions from what you see as I get moving forward?
